description: This file is a Java Spring MVC controller named ProductKeywordsController, managing product keyword functionalities in an admin panel, including displaying, adding, removing, and paginating keywords for a product.

classes.name: ProductKeywordsController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing product keywords in admin interface, including displaying current keywords, adding new keywords, removing existing ones, and paginating keywords.

methods.name: displayKeywords
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the keyword management view for a specific product.

methods.name: addKeyword
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a keyword to a product description in a specific language.

methods.name: removeKeyword
methods.description: Handles POST request to remove a specified keyword from a product description in a specific language.

methods.name: pageKeywords
methods.description: Handles POST request to provide a paginated list of keywords for a product, formatted as JSON.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up the menu and active links for the view.
